title: Give your AI agent a household task you can check
summary: Try a bounded household task with your AI agent: organize an umbrella insurance application, review available quotes, and decide whether to proceed.
body_markdown:
Your agent can help prepare an umbrella insurance application and compare available offers. You review the facts and approve submission and purchase.


[Start with your agent](https://www.coveragecat.com/landing/agent-umbrella?campaign=ba26_direct_task) , or[shop in your browser](https://www.coveragecat.com/umbrella) .


## Review coverage when you want to shop


Umbrella insurance can help with liability costs above primary policy limits. It does not cover damage to your own home or vehicle. Policy terms control.[(NAIC, "What's an Umbrella Policy?", 2022)](https://content.naic.org/article/whats-umbrella-policy)


Start with current liability limits and household facts you can confirm. Your assistant should flag missing information, not guess.


## Check each step


Checkpoint What to confirm


Draft Facts are correct; nothing has been submitted.


Submission You approved it; the service confirms it.


Offers Compare premiums, limits, and required underlying-policy changes.


Purchase The service confirms issuance. A selected offer or saved card is not active coverage.


The[setup guide](https://www.coveragecat.com/ai/shop-with-your-assistant) explains connections and website handoffs for uploads and checkout. If your assistant cannot connect, use the browser option.


## Include it in your household review


Already reviewing card fees or recurring bills? Use the[household finance checklist](https://www.coveragecat.com/ai/household-finance-review) to add liability coverage and compare combined costs.


Share the workflow using wholly synthetic demonstrations. Keep company and customer details, documents, application tokens, and payment information private.
